#include <iostream>
using namespace std;
const int MOD = 1000000007;

int mod_pow(int base, int exp) {
    long long result = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < exp; ++i) {
        result = (result * base) % MOD;
    }
    return (int)result;
}

int main() {
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << mod_pow(p, p - 1);
    } else if (k == 1) {
        cout << mod_pow(p, p);
    } else {
        int order = 1, current = k;
        while (current != 1) {
            current = (long long)current * k % p;
            order++;
        }
        cout << mod_pow(p, (p - 1) / order);
    }
    return 0;
}
